simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַזְכָּרָה (H234) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַזְכָּרָה (ʼazkârâh) means a reminder ; specifically remembrance-offering First listed occurrence: Lev 2 2.

definitions.full: H234. azkarah אַזְכָּרָה noun feminine memorial-offering , only P (an Aramaic infinitive form; compare Ba NB 90 Sta § 224 ) — absolute ׳א Lev 24:7 ; suffix אַזְכָּֽרָתָהּ 2:2 5 t.; — used of the frankincense burned for the shew-bread לאז ׳ללחם לי ׳אִשֶּׁה והיתה 24:7 ; elsewhere always after הקטיר , only with suffix, referring to מִנְחָה 2:2 , 9 , 16 ; 6:8 ; Num 5:26 ; of the meal used as חַטָּאת by the very poor Lev 5:12 ; always connected with אִשֶּׁה , except 6:8 ; Num 5:26 .
